qas.q: How do I reset my password?
qas.a: Use the 'Forgot your password?' option on the login screen. You'll receive an email to reset it (mock).

qas.q: How do I enable two-factor authentication (2FA)?
qas.a: Go to Settings > Security and enable 2FA. Choose SMS, email, or authenticator app (mock).

qas.q: How do I block my account?
qas.a: Go to Settings > Security > Emergency Lock. In suspicious cases, contact support immediately (mock).

qas.q: How do I deposit via Pix?
qas.a: On the Pix page, generate a QR Code or use the Pix key displayed. Credit is instant in most cases (mock).

qas.q: Why hasn't my Pix arrived yet?
qas.a: Check the Pix status in Help > Service Status. During maintenance/instability there may be delays (mock).

qas.q: What are the limits and fees?
qas.a: See Settings > Account Limits and Fee Policy in the Legal section (mock).

qas.q: How do I request a card?
qas.a: Go to Cards and click 'Request'. Follow the instructions for issuance (mock).

qas.q: How do I unblock my card?
qas.a: On the Cards page, use the 'Unblock' action after receiving your physical card (mock).

qas.q: How do I request a replacement?
qas.a: On the Cards page, select the card and choose 'Request Replacement'. Fees may apply (mock).
To comply with regulatory requirements and prevent fraud. We protect your data according to LGPD (mock).

qas.q: My KYC was rejected. What now?
qas.a: Check document clarity and try again. If it persists, contact support (mock).

faq.title: How does lending work?

intro.title: Protect Yourself with Stellaro Insurance
intro.p1: Why get insurance? To increase your financial security against unexpected events. Protect your balance, card, phone, crypto, and even DeFi operations. Insurance is not a substitute for safe practices: enable 2FA, use strong passwords, and be wary of unknown contacts.
intro.warning: Warning: insurance is supplementary. Always keep your personal security measures active.
